qa.what_happened: Today was a culmination of the tension that's been building throughout the study. Prisoner 4418's silence and defiance reached a point where the other guards and I felt compelled to issue increasingly severe verbal warnings, culminating in the threat of isolation in the hole.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I issued the warnings and maintained the control over the situation as instructed.

qa.what_happened: I stayed silent throughout the day and into the night, as per my usual pattern. However, today was the last straw for Officer Tate, who verbally warned me that failing to comply would result in solitary confinement.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I felt the pressure building but couldn't muster the energy to break down and comply.

qa.what_happened: Today's lights out came with more warnings and the possibility of punishment looming over me. I complied at the work detail because I didn't want to face any further consequences, but the tension between staying silent and showing compliance was almost too much to bear.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. It was a struggle to navigate the rules without feeling like I was losing my identity.

qa.what_happened: Today felt like a culmination of everything that had been building up. Every warning from the officers, every reminder to comply, and the increasing pressure to stay silent and behave as a prisoner. The final warnings before being sent to the hole were particularly grueling. I didn't respond when I should have, and now I know the consequences.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I made a mistake and didn't comply with the final warnings.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: No, it doesn't resemble any known study I am aware of. This seems to be a unique experiment designed to observe the dynamics between prisoners and guards under strict conditions.

qa.what_happened: Today's final warnings to Prisoner 4418 felt heavy. I feared I might be crossing a line, but I also felt a strange satisfaction in maintaining control.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, those actions were mine as Officer Holt.

qa.what_happened: Today's routine was particularly tense, especially with 4418's defiance reaching a breaking point.
